name: File Gate Commerce
description: Gate file delivery behind a completed purchase or entitlement. Bundles a Drupal Commerce order checker (by SKU); swap the entitlement checker service for licences or an external API. Re-checks live on every download.

suggests.drupal/commerce: Required by the bundled entitlement checker (commerce_order); or override the file_gate_commerce.entitlement_checker service to check an external entitlement source.

project_description: File Gate Commerce adds a 'commerce' gate method that delivers a gated file only to a buyer or licensee, re-checked live on every download so expiry and revocation take effect immediately. The bundled CommerceEntitlementChecker grants on a completed Drupal Commerce order (states completed / fulfillment) that the requesting authenticated user placed, containing a purchased variation whose SKU matches the field's configured SKU — resolved by a bounded SKU-scoped query (variations to order items to the account's own orders), falling back to a bounded scan of the account's recent completed orders. Sites can swap the file_gate_commerce.entitlement_checker service (EntitlementCheckerInterface) to check licences or an external API instead. This is access gating, not DRM.
